references.text: Jacob's blessing over Judah predicted the tribe's leadership role among the tribes of Israel, which is fulfilled when the Lord chooses Judah to go first in battle.
Judah was the first tribe to camp east of the tabernacle, showing the tribe's prominent position in Israel.
The banner of Judah went first when the Israelites broke camp, confirming the tribe's leadership role.
God promised to give the land into Israel's hands, a parallel to the promise that the land is given into Judah's hand.
The Lord promised to deliver the enemies into Israel's hand, using the same wording as for Judah's victory.
Later in Judges, the Lord again chooses Judah to go first in battle, showing a pattern.
David, from the tribe of Judah, was chosen to lead Israel, fulfilling Judah's selection for leadership.
